title: One-Pot Beef and Bean Chili
summary: A thick, beefy chili with black beans, peppers and tomatoes that simmers in one pot while you set the table. Makes great leftovers.

creator.bio: Sample creator. American weeknight basics that feed a crowd and leave few dishes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and break it up, cooking until browned with no pink left, about 7 minutes.
success_cues: Beef is browned in small crumbles
A thermometer in a pile of crumbles reads 160°F (71°C)
warnings: Hot oil can spit; add food away from your body and keep the handle turned inward.
Raw ground meat: wash hands and tools after handling. Check it reaches 160°F (71°C) with a thermometer rather than going by color.
steps.creator_note: Let the beef sit a minute between stirs so it actually browns.

steps.instruction: Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
success_cues: Spices smell toasty and coat the meat

steps.instruction: Add the tomatoes, beans, 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer partly covered for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
success_cues: Chili is thick enough that a spoon dragged through leaves a trail
warnings: Thick chili bubbles and spits; keep the lid partly on and stir with a long spoon.

steps.instruction: Taste and adjust salt and spice. Serve topped with cheddar if using.
success_cues: Rich, savory and as spicy as you like it

creator_notes: Leftovers freeze for up to three months.
dietary_warnings: Optional cheddar contains milk. Check chili powder labels for added wheat.
